description: Liquid-asset, outflow and inflow categories of each profile for the v0.1 perimeter (A03 to A08). Each category cites its locator in SRC-02 (EU) or SRC-06 (Basel); none holds a parameter value. 'collateral' says whether flows.csv must, may or must not give the collateral's asset category; 'excluded' lists categories rejected by my decisions.

assets.description: Physical coins and banknotes held by the institution.
assets.notes: No haircut under Art. 10(2) (remaining level 1 assets).

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, the ECB or a Member State central bank.
assets.notes: Counterparty/guarantor type; no haircut under Art. 10(2).

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, a third-country central bank whose exposures carry an ECAI assessment at the highest credit quality step.
assets.notes: Counterparty country; issuer/guarantor credit quality step of the central bank or its central government (Art. 114(2) CRR).

assets.description: Reserves held at a central bank covered by Art. 10(1)(b)(i) or (ii) that may be withdrawn at any time during stress.
assets.notes: Requires withdrawability in stress and withdrawal conditions set in an agreement or third-country rules; holder type (subsidiary or branch) determines which authority's agreement applies.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, the central government of a Member State.
assets.notes: Counterparty/guarantor type and country.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, a third-country central government assessed at the highest credit quality step.
assets.notes: issuer/guarantor credit quality step (Art. 114(2) CRR).

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, Member State regional governments or local authorities treated as exposures to their central government.
assets.notes: Requires treatment under Art. 115(2) CRR.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, regional governments or local authorities of a qualifying third country treated as exposures to that central government.
assets.notes: Third country must qualify under Art. 10(1)(c)(ii); requires treatment under Art. 115(4) CRR.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, public sector entities treated as exposures to a Member State central government or a qualifying regional or local authority.
assets.notes: Requires treatment under Art. 116(4) CRR.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, a third-country central government or central bank not assessed at the highest credit quality step.
assets.notes: Recognition capped per currency at stressed net outflows in that currency (Art. 10(1)(d), second and third subparagraphs); needs currency and whether it is the third country's domestic currency.

assets.description: Reserves held at a third-country central bank covered by Art. 10(1)(d)(i), withdrawable during stress.
assets.notes: Same currency cap as Art. 10(1)(d)(i) (aggregated with it); withdrawal conditions per agreement or third-country rules.

assets.description: Assets issued by a credit institution set up by a Member State central, regional or local government that is legally bound to protect its viability.
assets.notes: Issuer type and legal-obligation attribute; regional/local exposure treated as central government under Art. 115(2) CRR.

assets.description: Assets issued by a promotional lender whose loans are predominantly government-guaranteed promotional loans.
assets.notes: Issuer type; share of guaranteed loans must meet the minimum set in the point.

assets.description: Extremely high quality covered bonds meeting the issue size, rating or risk weight, cover pool and overcollateralisation criteria.
assets.notes: Subject to a distinct minimum haircut (Art. 10(2)); needs issue size, covered bond credit quality step or risk weight, overcollateralisation; point (iii) is deleted in the consolidated text.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, multilateral development banks and international organisations listed in Art. 117(2) and Art. 118 CRR.
assets.notes: Counterparty must be on the CRR lists.

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, Member State regional governments, local authorities or PSEs that carry the risk weight specified in the point.
assets.notes: Counterparty type and CRR risk weight; haircut per Art. 11(2).

assets.description: Claims on, or guaranteed by, a third-country central government, central bank, regional or local authority or PSE carrying the specified risk weight.
assets.notes: Counterparty type, country and CRR risk weight; haircut per Art. 11(2).

assets.description: High quality covered bonds meeting the point's issue size, rating or risk weight and overcollateralisation criteria.
assets.notes: Issue size, credit quality step or risk weight, overcollateralisation; point (iii) is deleted though (vi) still cites it; haircut per Art. 11(2).

assets.description: Covered bonds issued by third-country credit institutions under equivalent supervision and meeting the point's pool, transparency and rating criteria.
assets.notes: Issuer country, equivalence of supervision, credit quality step or risk weight, issue size (affects overcollateralisation); haircut per Art. 11(2).

assets.description: Corporate debt securities with the highest credit quality step, a minimum issue size and a capped original maturity.
assets.notes: Credit quality step, issue size, original maturity; haircut per Art. 11(2).

assets.description: Corporate debt securities meeting a lower minimum credit quality step, a minimum issue size and a capped original maturity.
assets.notes: Credit quality step, issue size, original maturity; haircut per Art. 12(2)(b); Art. 12(3) lets the authority waive size/maturity criteria for institutions barred from interest-bearing assets.

assets.description: Shares in a major stock index with a proven record as a reliable liquidity source in stress.
assets.notes: Index membership, currency vs home Member State currency (foreign-currency shares recognised only up to stressed net outflows in that currency), stress price record; haircut per Art. 12(2)(c).

assets.description: Covered bonds collateralised exclusively by specified CRR Art. 129(1) assets with a low risk-weight pool and the overcollateralisation and disclosure set in the point.
assets.notes: Issue size, cover pool composition and risk weights, overcollateralisation, monthly disclosure; haircut per Art. 12(2)(d); points (ii) and (iii) are deleted.

outflows.description: Other off-balance-sheet and contingent funding obligations, including uncommitted funding facilities.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority under Art. 23(2).

outflows.description: Undrawn loans and advances to wholesale counterparties.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority; counterparty type (wholesale).

outflows.description: Mortgage loans agreed but not yet drawn down.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority.

outflows.description: Credit card products.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority.

outflows.description: Overdraft products.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority.

outflows.description: Planned outflows from renewing existing or extending new retail or wholesale loans.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority.

outflows.description: Derivative payables on contracts outside CRR Annex II and other than credit derivatives.
outflows.notes: Rate determined by the competent authority; contract type; not netted under Art. 21.

outflows.description: Off-balance-sheet trade finance related products.
outflows.notes: Competent authority may apply a capped rate specific to trade finance (Art. 23(2)).

outflows.description: Other products or services offered, sponsored or associated with the institution not listed in Art. 23(1)(a)-(h) nor in Arts 27-31a.
outflows.notes: Residual of the non-exhaustive list; rate determined by the competent authority.

outflows.description: DGS-covered retail deposits in an established relationship or a transactional account.
outflows.notes: Counterparty retail; DGS coverage (covered amount only); established relationship (Art. 24(2)) or transactional account (Art. 24(3)); not if Art. 25(2), (3) or (5) higher-rate criteria are met.

outflows.description: Stable retail deposits covered by a Commission-approved DGS, up to the DGS coverage level, under authority permission.
outflows.notes: Requires competent authority authorisation with Commission approval (Art. 24(5)); DGS identity; amount up to the Directive 2014/49/EU coverage level.

outflows.description: Retail deposits covered by an equivalent third-country DGS where the authority allows a reduced rate.
outflows.notes: Requires competent authority authorisation and third-country permission; DGS coverage.

outflows.description: Retail deposits not treated as stable, including uncovered portions, without higher-risk features.
outflows.notes: Counterparty retail; DGS coverage; absence of Art. 25(2) criteria (after assessment).

outflows.description: Retail deposits meeting the large-balance criterion alone or two of the other Art. 25(2) risk criteria.
outflows.notes: Rate set by institution within a band; needs total client balance, internet-only flag, rate features, fixed term/notice within 30 days, residence/currency.

outflows.description: Retail deposits meeting the large-balance criterion plus another, or three or more Art. 25(2) criteria, or not yet assessed.
outflows.notes: Same inputs as band A; also applies where the Art. 25(2) assessment is missing or incomplete (Art. 25(3), second subparagraph).

outflows.description: Clearly circumscribed retail term deposits that cannot be withdrawn within 30 days or carry a qualifying early-withdrawal penalty.
outflows.notes: Withdrawal restriction or penalty terms; penalty-free withdrawable portion is treated as a demand deposit instead (second subparagraph).

outflows.description: Cancelled retail deposits with residual maturity within 30 days where payout to another credit institution is agreed.
outflows.notes: Cancellation status, residual maturity, payout destination.

outflows.description: Retail deposits taken in third countries where local liquidity law prescribes a higher outflow rate.
outflows.notes: Booking jurisdiction; third-country law rate overrides Arts 24 and 25(1)-(4).

outflows.description: Deposits maintained to obtain clearing, custody, cash management or similar services in an established operational relationship.
outflows.notes: Uncovered portion only (covered portion: Art. 27(2)); relationship critically important; excess over operational needs goes to non-operational (Art. 27(4)).

outflows.description: DGS-covered portion of operational deposits for clearing, custody, cash management or similar services.
outflows.notes: DGS coverage; applies only to Art. 27(1)(a) deposits.

outflows.description: Deposits from common task sharing in an IPS or cooperative network, or legally/contractually required deposits from a member.
outflows.notes: Counterparty membership in same IPS/network; not recognised as liquid assets by the depositor (Art. 27(3), Art. 16).

outflows.description: Deposits held in another established operational relationship, identified for non-financial customers via Art. 27(6).
outflows.notes: Non-financial customer; excludes term, savings and brokered deposits; pricing, designated account, transaction frequency, relationship length or active services (Art. 27(6)).

outflows.description: Deposits held to obtain cash clearing and central institution services where the institution belongs to an Art. 16 network or scheme.
outflows.notes: Network/scheme membership; established critically important relationship (Art. 27(4)).

outflows.description: Deposits placed at the central institution that the depositing member counts as liquid assets under Art. 16.
outflows.notes: Applies to the central institution; amount is the depositor's liquid asset value after haircut; linked to excluded Art. 16.

outflows.description: Deposits arising from correspondent banking or prime brokerage services, which cannot be operational.
outflows.notes: Relationship type.

outflows.description: Non-operational deposits from non-financial customers, sovereigns, central banks, MDBs, PSEs, credit unions, PICs or deposit brokers.
outflows.notes: Counterparty type; not under Art. 27; uncovered portion (covered portion: second subparagraph).

outflows.description: DGS-covered portion of non-operational deposits from the counterparty types listed in Art. 28(1).
outflows.notes: Counterparty type; DGS coverage.

outflows.description: Liabilities arising from the institution's own operating expenses.
Maturing secured funding or capital market-driven liabilities collateralised by level 1 assets other than extremely high quality covered bonds.
outflows.notes: Collateral asset category (level 1 except Art. 10(1)(f)); residual maturity within 30 days; counterparty (domestic CB / eligible counterparty derogations).

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities collateralised by extremely high quality covered bonds.
outflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 10(1)(f); residual maturity within 30 days.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities collateralised by level 2A assets.
outflows.notes: Collateral asset category (Art. 11); residual maturity within 30 days.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities collateralised by level 2B covered bonds.
outflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 12(1)(e); residual maturity within 30 days.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities collateralised by level 2B corporate debt, shares or non-interest-bearing assets.
outflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 12(1)(b), (c) or (f); eligible counterparty derogation may apply.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities collateralised by assets not falling in Art. 28(3)(a)-(h).
outflows.notes: Collateral not a qualifying liquid asset; eligible counterparty derogation may apply.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding or capital market-driven liabilities where the counterparty is the institution's domestic central bank.
outflows.notes: Counterparty is domestic central bank (Art. 28(8)); for branches, requires equal access to central bank liquidity.

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding liabilities with an eligible counterparty whose collateral would otherwise attract a higher rate than the derogation cap.
outflows.notes: Counterparty is an eligible counterparty (Art. 28(9), risk weight condition for PSEs/RGLAs); collateral category determining the unadjusted rate.

outflows.description: Collateral swaps maturing within 30 days where the asset borrowed has a lower haircut than the asset lent.
outflows.notes: Asset categories of both legs (lent and borrowed) and market value of asset borrowed; non-liquid assets take a full haircut.

outflows.description: Collateral swaps maturing within 30 days with the institution's domestic central bank.
outflows.notes: Counterparty is domestic central bank (Art. 28(8)); branch access condition.

outflows.description: Collateral swaps with an eligible counterparty that would otherwise attract a rate above the derogation cap.
outflows.notes: Eligible counterparty (Art. 28(9)); asset categories of both legs.

outflows.description: Notes, bonds and other debt securities issued by the institution, other than retail-only placements.
outflows.notes: Maturity/callability within 30 days (via Art. 22(2)(b)); retail-only bonds held in retail accounts are classified as retail deposits instead.

outflows.description: Assets borrowed unsecured and maturing within 30 days, assumed to run off in full.
outflows.notes: Not applicable where the institution owns the borrowed assets and they are outside the liquidity buffer.

outflows.description: Collateral other than cash and level 1 assets posted for CRR Annex II contracts and credit derivatives.
outflows.notes: Posted collateral asset category; contract type; derivative-related additional outflow, not a net derivative flow.

outflows.description: Extremely high quality covered bonds posted as collateral for CRR Annex II contracts and credit derivatives.
outflows.notes: Posted collateral asset category Art. 10(1)(f); derivative-related additional outflow.

outflows.description: Additional collateral or cash needs triggered by a material deterioration of the institution's credit quality.
outflows.notes: Contracts with downgrade triggers; required where the competent authority deems the outflow material.

outflows.description: Collateral needs from an adverse market scenario on derivatives, computed per Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/208.
outflows.notes: Only if material; computed by the historical look-back approach of 2017/208.

outflows.description: Net outflows expected within 30 days on CRR Annex II contracts and credit derivatives, netted per Art. 21.
outflows.notes: Netting set/counterparty with bilateral netting agreement; FX full-principal exchange netted regardless (Art. 21(2)); excludes Art. 30(1)-(3) amounts.

outflows.description: Short positions covered by unsecured security borrowing, unless return is required only after 30 days.
outflows.notes: Covering transaction type; borrowing return date; market value of securities sold short.

outflows.description: Short positions covered by a collateralised securities financing transaction, assumed maintained over the horizon.
outflows.notes: Covering transaction type; linked to inflow exclusion in Art. 32(3)(b), final subparagraph.

outflows.description: Excess collateral held that the counterparty can contractually call at any time.
Collateral due to be posted to a counterparty within 30 days.
Liquid-asset collateral received that the counterparty may substitute with non-liquid assets without consent.
outflows.notes: Collateral received asset category; substitution right without consent.

outflows.description: Loss of funding on ABS, covered bonds and other structured financing instruments maturing within 30 days issued by the institution or its sponsored conduits/SPVs.
outflows.notes: Issuer is the institution or a sponsored conduit/SPV; no double counting with associated liquidity facilities (Art. 30(10)).

outflows.description: Loss of funding on asset-backed commercial paper, conduits, securities investment vehicles and similar financing facilities.
outflows.notes: Amount is maturing amount or assets that could be returned; no double counting (Art. 30(10)).

outflows.description: Prime brokerage contingent obligation where client short sales are covered internally by another client's non-liquid assets.
outflows.notes: Prime brokerage flag; matched assets do not qualify as liquid assets.

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit and liquidity facilities qualifying for the retail deposit exposure class.
outflows.notes: Counterparty retail; maximum drawable within 30 days net of eligible collateral (Art. 31(2)).

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit facilities to non-retail clients that are not financial customers, not for replacing market funding.
outflows.notes: Facility type credit (incl. general working capital, Art. 31(1)); counterparty non-financial; purpose.

outflows.description: Undrawn committed liquidity facilities to non-retail clients that are not financial customers, other than PICs.
outflows.notes: Facility type liquidity; amount limited to backstopped debt maturing within 30 days, excess treated as credit facility (Art. 31(1)).

outflows.description: Undrawn committed liquidity facilities provided to personal investment companies.
outflows.notes: Counterparty PIC; same paragraph as EU-O-FAC-LIQ-NONFIN but a distinct rate.

outflows.description: Undrawn liquidity facilities to an SSPE for purchasing non-securities assets from non-financial clients, beyond assets already purchased.
outflows.notes: Counterparty SSPE; drawable amount contractually limited to assets currently purchased; only the excess portion.

outflows.description: Liquidity funding committed by a network central institution to a member that counts it as a liquid asset under Art. 16(2).
outflows.notes: Applies on committed principal; linked to excluded Art. 16.

outflows.description: Undrawn facilities to credit institutions, and credit facilities to other regulated financial institutions, CIUs or closed-ended schemes.
outflows.notes: Counterparty type and facility type (liquidity facilities to non-bank regulated FIs fall to Art. 31(8)(c)).

outflows.description: Liquidity facilities to SSPEs not covered by Art. 31(6), and arrangements obliging the institution to buy or swap SSPE assets.
outflows.notes: Counterparty SSPE.

outflows.description: Undrawn credit and liquidity facilities to other financial customers not covered elsewhere in Art. 31.
outflows.notes: Counterparty financial customer.

outflows.description: Facilities from government-sponsored institutions to promotional lenders solely for funding qualifying promotional loans.
outflows.notes: Provider is government-sponsored; rate follows Art. 31(3) or (4) per underlying loans; conditions in third subparagraph.

outflows.description: Facilities extended by an intermediary credit institution passing through promotional loans, with a symmetric inflow.
outflows.notes: Intermediary role; paired with EU-I-PROMO-PASS-THROUGH-FAC.

outflows.description: Any other liabilities becoming due within 30 days not covered by Arts 24 to 31.
outflows.notes: Residual maturity/callability within 30 days; includes e.g. deposits from financial customers not under Art. 27.

outflows.description: Excess of contractual funding commitments to non-financial customers within 30 days over the related Art. 32(3)(a) inflows.
outflows.notes: Aggregate computation; counterparty non-financial (excludes financial customers and central banks); commitments not under Arts 24-31.

inflows.description: Contractual inflows from exposures past due or expected not to perform within 30 days, which are not recognised.
inflows.notes: Past-due status; expectation of non-performance.

inflows.description: Monies due from central banks and financial customers with residual maturity within 30 days.
inflows.notes: Counterparty type; residual maturity; secured transactions go to Art. 32(3)(b).

inflows.description: Monies due within 30 days from trade finance transactions under Art. 162(3) CRR.
inflows.notes: Transaction type; residual maturity; applies regardless of counterparty.

inflows.description: Monies due from securities maturing within 30 days.
inflows.notes: Not if the security is counted as a liquid asset (Art. 32(6)).

inflows.description: Monies due within 30 days from major index equity positions, such as cash dividends and unsettled sales, without double counting liquid assets.
inflows.notes: Equity index membership; not recognised as liquid assets.

inflows.description: Other performing contractual inflows within 30 days not specifically treated in Art. 32(3).
inflows.notes: Residual of Art. 32(2) list ('including in particular').

inflows.description: Monies due within 30 days from non-financial customers, excluding trade finance and maturing securities, with principal reduced.
inflows.notes: Counterparty non-financial (Art. 31a(2) meaning); principal vs interest; does not apply to SFTs collateralised by liquid assets (Art. 32(4)).

inflows.description: Inflows of an intermediary disbursing promotional loans under a commitment received, recognised up to the matching outflow.
inflows.notes: Intermediary role; commitment from government-sponsored CI, MDB or PSE; capped at corresponding outflow.

inflows.description: Maturing reverse repo/secured lending and capital market-driven inflows collateralised by level 1 assets other than extremely high quality covered bonds.
inflows.notes: Collateral asset category regardless of reuse; residual maturity within 30 days.

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending inflows collateralised by extremely high quality covered bonds.
inflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 10(1)(f).

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending inflows collateralised by level 2A assets.
inflows.notes: Collateral asset category (Art. 11).

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending inflows collateralised by level 2B covered bonds.
inflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 12(1)(e).

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending inflows collateralised by level 2B corporate debt, shares or non-interest-bearing assets.
inflows.notes: Collateral asset category Art. 12(1)(b), (c) or (f).

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending inflows collateralised by assets not falling in Art. 32(3)(b)(i)-(viii).
inflows.notes: Collateral not a qualifying liquid asset; non-financial counterparty reduction of Art. 32(3)(a) still applies to these per Art. 32(4).

inflows.description: Secured lending where the collateral received covers a short position under Art. 30(5), second sentence; no inflow recognised.
inflows.notes: Link between collateral received and short position.

inflows.description: Contractual margin loans maturing within 30 days made against non-liquid collateral not used to cover shorts.
inflows.notes: Collateral non-liquid; collateral not reused for short positions; optional treatment ('may').

inflows.description: Monies due that the owing institution treats as operational deposits under Art. 27, at the corresponding symmetric rate.
inflows.notes: Counterparty's Art. 27 treatment known; excludes Art. 27(3) central institution deposits.

inflows.description: Operational deposits held at other institutions where the symmetric rate cannot be established.
inflows.notes: Counterparty's treatment unknown.

inflows.description: Collateral swaps maturing within 30 days where the asset lent has a lower haircut than the asset borrowed.
inflows.notes: Asset categories of both legs and market value of asset lent; non-liquid assets take a full haircut.

inflows.description: Reverse repos, borrowings or swaps maturing within 30 days whose collateral covers shorts extendable beyond 30 days; assumed rolled over, no inflow.
inflows.notes: Link to short positions (including matched-book cases); overlaps with Art. 32(3)(b) final subparagraph.

inflows.description: Undrawn credit or liquidity facilities and other commitments received, including from central banks, not recognised as inflows.
inflows.notes: Except Art. 31(9) second-subparagraph pass-through facilities and Art. 34 (excluded).

inflows.description: Monies due from securities issued by the institution or a close-links SSPE, netted and rated by the underlying assets.
inflows.notes: Issuer relationship (own or close links); underlying asset inflow category.

inflows.description: Loans with no defined contractual end date where the institution can demand payment within 30 days.
inflows.notes: Contractual call right within 30 days.

inflows.description: Undrawn committed facility received by an intermediary passing through promotional loans, given a symmetric inflow.
inflows.notes: Derogation from Art. 32(3)(g); paired with EU-O-FAC-PROMO-PASS-THROUGH.

inflows.description: Release of balances in regulatory segregated accounts for customer trading assets, maintained in liquid assets.
inflows.notes: Segregation held in liquid assets; such balances are excluded from the liquid asset stock (Art. 28(5)).

inflows.description: Net inflows expected within 30 days on CRR Annex II contracts and credit derivatives, netted per Art. 21.
inflows.notes: Netting set/counterparty with bilateral netting agreement; collateral to be received nets only if liquid and reusable (Art. 21(3)).

inflows.description: Inflows from liquid assets reflected in their market value, which are not recognised.
inflows.notes: Payments not reflected in market value (e.g. coupons) are recognised under the relevant inflow category.

inflows.description: Inflows from new obligations entered into, which are not recognised.
inflows.notes: Contract start date relative to reporting date.

assets.description: Coins and banknotes held by the bank, counted at full value without haircut.
assets.notes: instrument type

assets.description: Central bank reserves, including required reserves and qualifying overnight or term deposits with the central bank, to the extent they can be drawn down in stress.
assets.notes: central bank; drawdown-in-stress extent agreed locally (footnote 10); term deposit repayable on notice or usable as collateral for borrowing (footnote 9); other central bank term deposits are not HQLA

assets.description: Marketable securities claimed on or guaranteed by sovereigns, central banks, PSEs, BIS, IMF, ECB/EC, ESM, EFSF or MDBs that meet the Level 1 risk-weight, market-depth, proven-liquidity and non-financial-issuer conditions.
assets.notes: issuer/guarantor type; standardised risk weight per CRE20.7 (not via CRE20.8 discretion); repo/cash market depth; proven liquidity record; not a financial institution obligation; LCR30.40 lets supervisors impose a haircut on Level 1 securities

assets.description: Debt securities of a sovereign or central bank whose risk weight is not the lowest, issued in domestic currency in the country where liquidity risk is taken or in the home country.
assets.notes: issuer sovereign/central bank; sovereign risk weight; currency of issue equals issuer domestic currency; issuer country is home country or host country with subsidiary/branch presence (FAQ1); LCR30.40 haircut discretion

assets.description: Domestic sovereign or central bank debt in foreign currency, for a sovereign whose risk weight is not the lowest, eligible only up to stressed net outflows in that currency in that jurisdiction.
assets.notes: issuer sovereign/central bank; currency; jurisdiction of operations; bank's stressed net cash outflows in that currency in the issuer's jurisdiction (FAQ2) to cap eligible amount; LCR30.40 haircut discretion

assets.description: Marketable securities claimed on or guaranteed by sovereigns, central banks, PSEs or MDBs in the Level 2A risk-weight bucket that meet market-depth, price-stability and non-financial-issuer conditions.
assets.notes: issuer/guarantor type; standardised risk weight; market depth; stressed price decline or haircut increase; not a financial institution obligation; if also eligible under LCR30.41(4)/(5) it may be assigned Level 1 (footnote 14)

assets.description: Plain-vanilla corporate debt securities, including commercial paper, from non-financial issuers with external or internal rating meeting the Level 2A minimum and proven stressed liquidity.
assets.notes: issuer non-financial; external ECAI rating or internal PD-equivalent rating; plain-vanilla, not structured or subordinated (footnote 16); stressed price decline or haircut increase; securities meeting rating but failing the Level 2A price test may go to Level 2B (FAQ1)

assets.description: Covered bonds not issued by the bank itself or its affiliates, with rating meeting the Level 2A minimum and proven stressed liquidity.
assets.notes: instrument type covered bond (footnote 17); issuer not the bank or affiliate; external or internal rating; market depth; stressed price decline or haircut increase

assets.description: Residential mortgage-backed securities meeting the Level 2B conditions on originator, rating, liquidity, pool composition, full recourse, average LTV and risk retention.
assets.notes: not issued/originated by bank or affiliate; long-term or short-term rating; market depth; stressed price behaviour; pool restricted to residential mortgages, no structured products; full-recourse loans; weighted-average LTV at RMBS issuance (FAQ1, FAQ2); risk retention; inclusion of Level 2B at national discretion (LCR30.44)

assets.description: Plain-vanilla corporate debt securities, including commercial paper, of non-financial issuers rated within the Level 2B range and meeting liquidity conditions.
assets.notes: issuer non-financial; external or internal rating; plain-vanilla (footnote 19); market depth; stressed price behaviour; also receives higher-rated corporates failing the Level 2A price test (LCR30.43 FAQ1); inclusion of Level 2B at national discretion (LCR30.44)

assets.description: Exchange-traded, centrally cleared common equity shares of non-financial issuers that belong to a major index and meet currency and stressed price conditions.
assets.notes: issuer non-financial; exchange-traded and centrally cleared; constituent of major index in home or risk-taking jurisdiction as decided by supervisor (FAQ5, FAQ8); currency; stressed price behaviour with nationally determined stress period (FAQ7); inclusion of Level 2B at national discretion (LCR30.44)

assets.description: Sovereign, central bank and PSE debt securities within the Level 2B rating range that do not qualify as Level 1 or Level 2A, treated like Level 2B corporate debt.
assets.notes: issuer sovereign/central bank/PSE; rating; not eligible under LCR30.41 or LCR30.43; PSE securities must meet the other LCR30.45(2) requirements (FAQ4); inclusion of Level 2B at national discretion (LCR30.44)

outflows.description: Stable retail deposits in jurisdictions that apply the reduced stable rate because the deposit insurance scheme meets the additional prefunding, backstop and payout criteria.
outflows.notes: counterparty natural person; fully insured portion; effective deposit insurance (LCR40.8-40.9); established relationship or transactional account; jurisdiction opts in (LCR40.11-40.12); not term deposit excluded under LCR40.16

outflows.description: Retail deposits fully insured by an effective deposit insurance scheme or equivalent public guarantee, held by depositors with established relationships or in transactional accounts.
outflows.notes: counterparty natural person; insured amount up to insurance limit (footnote 43); established relationship or transactional account; demand or term deposit callable within horizon; rate is a floor that jurisdictions may raise (LCR40.6); retail-only bank debt securities may be included (LCR40.43)

outflows.description: Retail deposits not qualifying as stable, allocated to supervisor-defined less stable buckets with jurisdiction-specific run-off rates subject to a floor.
outflows.notes: counterparty natural person; uninsured or partially insured portion, high-value, sophisticated/HNW, internet, or unidentifiable stability (LCR40.14); jurisdiction bucket identifier

outflows.description: Retail deposits denominated in a currency other than the domestic currency of the jurisdiction, with run-off rate set by supervisors.
outflows.notes: counterparty natural person; deposit currency vs domestic currency of jurisdiction; treat as less stable if more volatile

outflows.description: Retail term deposits with residual maturity or notice beyond the LCR horizon whose early withdrawal is legally barred or carries a significant penalty, excluded unless supervisors set a run-off.
outflows.notes: counterparty natural person; residual maturity or notice period; legal right to withdraw; early-withdrawal penalty vs interest loss; penalty-free portion goes to demand categories (footnote 47); bank practice of waiving penalty reclassifies whole category (LCR40.17); supervisors may apply a run-off (LCR40.18)

outflows.description: Deposits contractually pledged to secure a bank loan not maturing within the horizon, excluded up to the outstanding loan balance.
outflows.notes: pledge legally prevents withdrawal until loan repaid; loan maturity beyond horizon; excluded amount capped at drawn loan balance; deposits pledged against undrawn facilities take the higher of the two applicable rates; also applies to small business deposits (LCR40.23 FAQ1)

outflows.description: Unsecured precious metals deposits that a jurisdiction allows to be treated as having no outflow when physically settled from own inventory or at the bank's option.
outflows.notes: liability denominated in precious metals; settlement type physical or bank option; bank holds inventory; otherwise classify by counterparty in retail or unsecured wholesale categories; supervisor must disclose use

outflows.description: Stable small business funding in jurisdictions applying the reduced stable rate under the enhanced deposit insurance criteria, by analogy with retail buckets.
outflows.notes: non-financial small business customer per CRE30.20-30.22 or managed as retail (LCR40.24); aggregated funding below the euro-denominated limit on consolidated basis (LCR40.23); insured portion; enhanced scheme criteria of LCR40.11

outflows.description: Stable portion of unsecured funding from small business customers, treated like stable retail deposits.
outflows.notes: non-financial small business customer; aggregated funding limit (LCR40.23-40.24); insured portion; established relationship or transactional account; floor that jurisdictions may raise (LCR40.6)

outflows.description: Less stable unsecured funding from small business customers, placed in the supervisor-defined less stable retail buckets.
outflows.notes: non-financial small business customer; aggregated funding limit; uninsured or otherwise less stable portion; jurisdiction bucket identifier

outflows.description: Foreign-currency funding from small business customers, receiving the supervisor-set foreign currency retail treatment by analogy.
outflows.notes: non-financial small business customer; currency vs domestic currency; LCR40.15 by reference

outflows.description: Small business term deposits beyond the horizon meeting the retail term deposit exclusion conditions, excluded unless supervisors set a run-off.
outflows.notes: non-financial small business customer; residual maturity or notice; withdrawal right; penalty; LCR40.16-40.18 by reference

outflows.description: Operational deposits required for qualifying clearing, custody or cash management services where the customer has substantive dependency on the bank, excluding the insured portion.
outflows.notes: counterparty financial or non-financial institutional customer; qualifying service (LCR40.27, LCR40.33-40.35); legally binding agreement with notice or switching costs; designated account with no pricing incentive (LCR40.28); operational portion only, excess balances go to non-operational categories (LCR40.29-40.30); not correspondent banking or prime brokerage (LCR40.32); supervisory approval and supervisor may disallow (concentration)

outflows.description: Portion of qualifying operational deposits fully covered by deposit insurance, which may be treated like stable retail deposits.
outflows.notes: operational deposit criteria as for BASEL-O-OPER-DEP; insured portion; inherits supervisory permission of LCR40.26

outflows.description: Deposits of member institutions placed with the central institution of a cooperative network for statutory minimum deposit or common task-sharing reasons, under a mutual protection scheme.
outflows.notes: reporting bank is approved central institution or central service provider (LCR40.39); depositor is network member; same mutual protection scheme; purpose statutory minimum deposit or task sharing; correspondent banking and other placements go to BASEL-O-UNSEC-OTHER-LE

outflows.description: Non-operational unsecured funding from non-financial corporates, sovereigns, central banks, MDBs and PSEs whose entire amount is covered by deposit insurance or equivalent guarantee.
outflows.notes: counterparty type; not small business; no operational relationship; entire deposit fully insured

outflows.description: Non-operational unsecured funding from non-financial corporates (not small business) and domestic or foreign sovereigns, central banks, MDBs and PSEs.
outflows.notes: counterparty type; not small business; no operational relationship or excess operational balances; non-financial corporate affiliates included (footnote 54)

outflows.description: Unsecured funding from banks, securities firms, insurers, fiduciaries, beneficiaries, conduits, SPVs, financial affiliates and other legal entities, plus bank-issued debt securities not restricted to retail holders.
outflows.notes: counterparty type; not operational, not cooperative-network qualifying; includes bank's own notes and bonds regardless of holder unless retail-only (LCR40.43); includes correspondent banking and non-qualifying placements at a cooperative central institution (LCR40.39)

outflows.description: Wholesale funding that is not callable and does not mature within the horizon, including funding callable only with binding notice beyond the horizon, which is not included.
outflows.notes: earliest contractual maturity or call date; investor options; bank options with reputational redemption expectation must be included (LCR40.20); binding notice period

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding and collateral swaps backed by Level 1 collateral with any counterparty, or with the bank's domestic central bank, with no assumed loss of funding.
outflows.notes: collateral HQLA level (actually pledged at close of business, LCR40.48); counterparty domestic central bank; maturity within horizon; amount of funds raised; host central bank possible under LCR40.47 FAQ2

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding and collateral swaps backed by Level 2A collateral with counterparties other than the domestic central bank.
outflows.notes: collateral HQLA level; counterparty; maturity within horizon; amount of funds raised; rate equals Level 2A haircut

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding with the domestic sovereign, MDBs or domestic PSEs in the lowest risk-weight buckets, backed by collateral other than Level 1 or Level 2A.
outflows.notes: counterparty domestic sovereign, MDB or domestic PSE with qualifying risk weight (footnote 55); domestic means place of incorporation, extension per FAQ2; collateral not Level 1 or Level 2A; outstanding transactions only, not unused capacity

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding and collateral swaps backed by RMBS eligible for Level 2B.
outflows.notes: collateral HQLA level and sub-type RMBS; counterparty not domestic central bank or qualifying domestic public entity; maturity within horizon

outflows.description: Maturing secured funding and collateral swaps backed by Level 2B assets other than eligible RMBS.
outflows.notes: collateral HQLA level and sub-type; counterparty; maturity within horizon

outflows.description: All other maturing secured funding, including non-HQLA-backed transactions and customer short positions covered from the bank's own long inventory, assumed to run off fully.
outflows.notes: collateral non-HQLA or not otherwise classified; counterparty; maturity within horizon or no contractual maturity for customer shorts (LCR40.46); collateral lent to customers for shorts counts as secured funding

outflows.description: Net derivative cash outflows calculated by counterparty under valid master netting agreements, fully counted as outflows.
outflows.notes: netting set / master netting agreement; in-the-money options exercisable within horizon; cheapest-to-deliver assumption; same-day FX principal exchanges may be netted; net of HQLA collateral inflows that can be re-used (LCR40.50); excludes valuation-driven collateral needs

outflows.description: Collateral postings, facility drawdowns or early repayments triggered by a downgrade of the bank's long-term rating within the scenario specified in the standard.
outflows.notes: contract contains rating trigger; trigger notch level vs scenario; short-term rating triggers mapped to long-term equivalent; applies to derivatives and other transactions not otherwise captured (FAQ2)

outflows.description: Potential loss of value on non-Level 1 collateral posted to secure mark-to-market exposures on derivatives and other transactions.
outflows.notes: posted collateral HQLA level (non-Level 1); amount net of reusable collateral received from same counterparty; segregated margin account offsets only within account; not secured funding or lending (FAQ2)

outflows.description: Excess non-segregated collateral held by the bank that the counterparty could contractually recall at any time.
outflows.notes: collateral non-segregated; excess over counterparty's current requirement; included in HQLA or recall needs funding

outflows.description: Collateral the bank is contractually obliged to post but which the counterparty has not yet demanded.
outflows.notes: contractually due collateral amount; not yet called

outflows.description: Non-segregated HQLA collateral received that the counterparty may substitute without consent with non-HQLA or lower-value HQLA.
outflows.notes: received collateral HQLA level and haircut; potential substitute lowest liquidity value; non-segregated; unencumbered collateral excluded from HQLA for operational reasons may be excluded; includes secured lending beyond horizon (FAQ1)

outflows.description: Liquidity needs from market valuation changes on derivative and other transactions, measured by the historical look-back of largest net collateral flows.
outflows.notes: portfolio-level historical net collateral flows over the look-back window (FAQ1); includes settled-to-market payments (FAQ2); supervisors may adjust the treatment

outflows.description: Bank-issued asset-backed securities, covered bonds and other structured financing instruments maturing within the horizon, assumed not refinanced.
outflows.notes: issuer is the bank; instrument type; maturity within horizon; may be offset by HQLA released on maturity, surplus recognised under LCR40.93

outflows.description: Debt maturing within the horizon issued by ABCP programmes, conduits, SIVs, SPEs and similar financing facilities of the bank, looked through regardless of consolidation.
outflows.notes: financing vehicle sponsored by bank; look-through maturity of vehicle debt; no double count with liquidity facilities for consolidated programmes (LCR40.63)

outflows.description: Assets that could be returned, or liquidity that must be provided, under embedded options or liquidity puts in the bank's structured financing arrangements.
outflows.notes: embedded option or liquidity put exercisable within horizon; returnable asset amount or liquidity required

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit and liquidity facilities to retail and small business customers.
outflows.notes: counterparty retail or small business; committed (irrevocable) or conditionally revocable; undrawn amount net of eligible HQLA collateral (LCR40.60)

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit facilities to non-financial corporates, sovereigns, central banks, PSEs and MDBs.
outflows.notes: counterparty type; facility type credit including general working capital and liquidity facility capacity beyond backstopped debt (LCR40.61); import/export financing (LCR40.72); undrawn amount net of HQLA collateral

outflows.description: Undrawn committed liquidity facilities to non-financial corporates, sovereigns, central banks, PSEs and MDBs.
outflows.notes: counterparty type; facility type liquidity; amount limited to customer debt maturing within horizon backstopped by facility (LCR40.61)

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit and liquidity facilities to banks subject to prudential supervision.
outflows.notes: counterparty prudentially supervised bank; committed; undrawn amount

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit facilities to other financial institutions such as securities firms, insurers, fiduciaries and beneficiaries.
outflows.notes: counterparty other financial institution; facility type credit; undrawn amount

outflows.description: Undrawn committed liquidity facilities to other financial institutions such as securities firms, insurers, fiduciaries and beneficiaries.
outflows.notes: counterparty other financial institution; facility type liquidity; undrawn amount

outflows.description: Undrawn committed credit and liquidity facilities to other legal entities, including SPEs, conduits, SPVs, hedge funds and money market funds.
outflows.notes: counterparty other legal entity; facilities to hedge funds, MMFs, SPEs, conduits and vehicles financing the bank's own assets captured entirely (LCR40.62)

outflows.description: Contractual obligations to extend funds within the horizon to financial institutions, including central banks, not captured elsewhere.
outflows.notes: counterparty financial institution or central bank; contractual; within horizon; not a committed facility

outflows.description: Excess of contractual obligations to extend funds to retail and non-financial wholesale clients over the specified share of contractual inflows from those clients.
outflows.notes: counterparty retail or non-financial wholesale; contractual lending obligations within horizon; contractual inflows from same client group; aggregate comparison

outflows.description: Non-contractual liquidity support expected for unconsolidated joint ventures or minority investments where the bank is the main liquidity provider.
outflows.notes: entity not consolidated per LCR10.1; bank expected main liquidity provider; amount per supervisor-agreed methodology

outflows.description: Contingent obligations from trade finance instruments such as documentary letters of credit, collections, import/export bills and trade-related guarantees.
outflows.notes: instrument type trade finance; directly underpinned by movement of goods or services; lending commitments such as import/export financing excluded (LCR40.72)

outflows.description: Unconditionally revocable uncommitted credit and liquidity facilities.
outflows.notes: facility unconditionally cancellable by bank (LCR40.59)

outflows.description: Guarantees and letters of credit not related to trade finance obligations.
outflows.notes: instrument type guarantee or letter of credit; not trade finance

outflows.description: Non-contractual obligations from potential requests to repurchase the bank's own debt or that of related conduits, SIVs and similar vehicles.
outflows.notes: non-contractual; issuer bank or related vehicle

outflows.description: Non-contractual obligations from structured products where customers expect ready marketability, such as adjustable rate and variable-rate demand notes.
outflows.notes: non-contractual; product type

outflows.description: Non-contractual obligations from managed funds marketed to maintain a stable value, such as money market mutual funds.
outflows.notes: non-contractual; fund marketed as stable value; sponsored by bank

outflows.description: Potential repurchase of outstanding secured or unsecured debt securities with maturities beyond the horizon, for issuers with an affiliated dealer or market maker.
outflows.notes: issuer has affiliated dealer/market maker; debt maturity beyond horizon

outflows.description: Non-contractual obligations where customer short positions are internally covered by other customers' collateral that is not Level 1 or Level 2, subject to a minimum run-off floor.
outflows.notes: customer short covered by other customers' collateral; collateral HQLA level (non-HQLA); symmetric with margin loan inflow (FAQ1)

outflows.description: Other contractual or non-contractual contingent funding obligations not listed elsewhere, such as autocallable notes, with nationally determined run-off rates.
outflows.notes: contingent liability type and trigger; contractual or non-contractual (LCR40.68-40.69); autocallable or market-triggered notes (LCR40.69 FAQ1)

outflows.description: Any other contractual cash outflows within the horizon, such as unsecured collateral borrowings, uncovered and firm shorts covered by unsecured borrowing, dividends and contractual interest.
outflows.notes: contractual; within horizon; includes firm shorts covered by unsecured security borrowing (LCR40.80), forward reverse repos starting within and maturing beyond horizon net of collateral value and unsettled non-HQLA purchases (FAQ1-FAQ2), re-used unsecured borrowed securities (FAQ4), collateral pool substitution needs (LCR40.88 FAQ1)

outflows.description: Outflows related to operating costs, which are not included in the LCR.
outflows.notes: outflow nature operating cost

outflows.description: Bank short positions covered by a collateralised securities financing transaction, assumed to be maintained with no outflow.
outflows.notes: short position of the bank; covering transaction is collateralised SFT; symmetric with zero inflow under LCR40.79

inflows.description: Maturing reverse repos and securities borrowing backed by Level 1 collateral not used to cover shorts, assumed rolled over with no inflow.
inflows.notes: collateral HQLA level; contractual maturity within horizon (FAQ1); collateral not rehypothecated to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing reverse repos, securities borrowing and collateral swaps backed by Level 2A collateral not used to cover shorts, with inflow equal to the Level 2A haircut.
inflows.notes: collateral HQLA level; maturity within horizon; collateral not used to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending backed by Level 2B eligible RMBS not used to cover shorts, with inflow equal to the RMBS haircut.
inflows.notes: collateral HQLA level and sub-type RMBS; maturity within horizon; not used to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing secured lending backed by other Level 2B collateral not used to cover shorts, with inflow equal to the corresponding haircut.
inflows.notes: collateral HQLA level and sub-type; maturity within horizon; not used to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing margin loans to customers for leveraged trading backed by non-HQLA collateral, recognised only partially.
inflows.notes: product margin loan; collateral non-HQLA; contractual maturity within horizon, term provisions allowing later repayment give no inflow (FAQ1); collateral not used to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing reverse repos and securities borrowing backed by non-HQLA collateral, not rolled over, with full return of cash assumed.
inflows.notes: collateral non-HQLA; not margin loan; maturity within horizon; collateral not used to cover shorts

inflows.description: Maturing reverse repos, securities borrowing or collateral swaps whose collateral is rehypothecated to cover short positions, assumed rolled over with no inflow.
inflows.notes: collateral re-used to cover firm or customer short positions evaluated at calculation date (FAQ2); any collateral level; substitution rights ignored

inflows.description: Credit, liquidity or other contingent funding facilities the bank holds at other institutions, assumed not drawable.
inflows.notes: facility received by reporting bank; includes central bank facilities (LCR40.75)

inflows.description: Fully performing contractual payments due within the horizon from retail and small business customers, partially recognised to reflect continued lending.
inflows.notes: counterparty retail or small business; fully performing; contractually due within horizon at latest possible date (LCR40.84); minimum payments on open-maturity loans included (LCR40.85)

inflows.description: Fully performing contractual payments due within the horizon from financial institutions and central banks, fully recognised.
inflows.notes: counterparty financial institution or central bank; not operational deposit; includes non-operational placements and excess balances of operational/correspondent deposits (LCR40.83, LCR40.89); central bank term deposits maturing within horizon (LCR30.41 footnote 9)

inflows.description: Fully performing contractual payments due within the horizon from non-financial wholesale counterparties such as corporates, sovereigns, MDBs and PSEs, partially recognised.
inflows.notes: counterparty non-financial wholesale; fully performing; due within horizon

inflows.description: Securities maturing within the horizon that are not in the stock of HQLA, treated like inflows from financial institutions.
inflows.notes: security not counted in HQLA (including Level 1/2 failing operational requirements or encumbered, FAQ1); maturity within horizon

inflows.description: Release of regulatory segregated balances for customer trading asset protection maintained in HQLA, treated like inflows from financial institutions.
inflows.notes: segregated account under client protection rules; maintained in HQLA; consistent with related outflows and inflows; excluded from HQLA (LCR40.44)

inflows.description: Level 1 and Level 2 assets maturing within the horizon that meet HQLA requirements, counted in the stock and not as inflows.
inflows.notes: asset in stock of HQLA meeting LCR30.13-30.45; no double counting (LCR40.4)

inflows.description: Operational deposits, including correspondent banking deposits, placed by the bank at other financial institutions, assumed to stay there with no inflow.
inflows.notes: deposit placed by reporting bank; operational per LCR40.26-40.36 methodology or correspondent banking; excess balances proven withdrawable go to BASEL-I-WHOLESALE-FI-CB

inflows.description: Deposits held at the central institution of a cooperative banking network that are assumed to remain there, with no inflow.
inflows.notes: reporting bank network member; deposit qualifying under LCR40.37-40.39

inflows.description: Net derivative cash inflows calculated under the LCR40.49 methodology, fully recognised.
inflows.notes: netting set / master netting agreement; in-the-money options (LCR40.49 FAQ1); net of collateral outflows for HQLA-collateralised derivatives (LCR40.92)

inflows.description: Other contractual cash inflows, includable at national discretion with supervisor-set inflow rates.
inflows.notes: inflow type; includes forward repos starting within and maturing beyond horizon, unsettled non-HQLA sales (FAQ1-FAQ2), unsecured lent HQLA returnable within horizon (LCR40.74 FAQ3), surplus HQLA released by own ABS/covered bond maturity (LCR40.57)

inflows.description: Cash inflows related to non-financial revenues, not taken into account.
inflows.notes: inflow nature non-financial revenue

inflows.description: Contingent inflows and inflows from exposures not fully performing or with expected default within the horizon, excluded.
inflows.notes: performing status; default expectation; contingent nature; contractual right to substitute collateral is contingent (FAQ1)

inflows.description: Inflows from loans with no specific maturity or contractually terminable within the horizon beyond regular amortisation, excluded except contractually due minimum payments.
inflows.notes: loan maturity defined or open; termination right; minimum payments due within horizon go to counterparty categories

inflows.description: Existing drawn amounts under revolving credit facilities, assumed rolled over and not giving rise to inflows.
inflows.notes: product revolving credit facility; undrawn balance treated as committed facility outflow under LCR40.64
